lines.text: Welcome back, coders! Today you will put a loop inside a loop to make amazing pattern art.
The inner loop draws one square.
The outer loop repeats the whole square and turns a little each time.
This is called a nested loop.
Multiply to find how many times the inside blocks run.
An outer loop of 8 and an inner loop of 4 means the move block runs 8 × 4 = 32 times!
Use “set pen color” and “set pen size” before you draw.
Change the colour inside the outer loop to make a rainbow pattern.
To spread shapes evenly around a circle, divide 360 by the number of shapes.
8 squares → turn 45 degrees after each one.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
